about: The falsifier: A26 at 296 was 92 own lines, each belonging to one of 8 places, accepted with --place for all 8. Every named place admitted every line by its signature, so each lock took all of them: 300 lines per lock, 64 region/vocabulary lines each, every lock offering the others' regions. The gates stayed green because no render moved. Lane A repaired it through the fold with 8 single-place lots (A27, 297), and the owner ruled no multi-place own lot with differing values until this guard lands.
